name: booklet
description: The week's reflection as a small booklet, one leaf at a time below desktop and open at a spread of two from the container's 1200: its leaves (the leaf component, rendered here from the page's data so a static screen opens on the right one), their paper and lift, the stitches across the fold, the ribbon, and the pager under it (arrows and "Page 2 of 6"). Its script turns the leaves: arrows, a swipe, a tap on a leaf's outer thirds on a phone, the Left and Right keys; leaves out of view are inert.

at.description: The leaf it opens on, 0-based: 0 on every static screen (leaves 1 and 2 on desktop, where the spread pairs a left leaf with the right one after it); the rated state opens on the rated note's leaf. Written as data-pos on each leaf (now, past, next), inert on the rest, and data-at on the root; live, the script takes over.

label.description: The booklet's name: "Reflection, 3 to 9 Aug" (aria-label, with aria-roledescription "booklet").

leaves.description: The leaves in order, each the leaf's props plus its slots and an id: { id?: "sleep", name?, form, kicker, date, line, big, words, back, picture, foot }. The booklet numbers them (number), names each "2 of 6: What you kept" (the end leaf "6 of 6: the end"; a leaf's name, when given, in place of its kicker: a skeleton leaf, whose kicker is a bone, is "1 of 2: loading"), sides them (data-side l, r), places them (role leaf) and gives each with an id the element id "leaf-<id>", which Timeline's way back names in the hash.

labels.description: The pager's words: { prev: "Previous page", next: "Next page", page: "Page {a} of {n}", pages: "Pages {a} and {b} of {n}", name: "booklet" }; these are the defaults.

places.leaf: a leaf: below desktop all in one grid cell, the one in view on top (z by distance), turned leaves rotated over the spine (rotateY -96deg from the left edge, --g-turn on --gc) and faded, leaves to come hidden under it; from 1200 two columns of one paper (the leaf's paper, edge and padding exposed properties set to bare and --s9 --s9 --s6), the spread in view fading in

states.default: yes: open on its first leaf (the first spread on desktop), the back arrow disabled
states.hover: yes: an arrow's ground lightens to --paper (pointer devices)
states.focus-visible: yes: the arrows take the product's ring
states.active: yes: a leaf turning over the spine (the transition), or the spread fading in
states.disabled: yes: the back arrow on the first leaf, the next arrow on the last (opacity .3)
states.selected: yes: the leaf in view, data-pos now (at): the rated state opens on its note's leaf
states.empty: yes: one leaf (the week so far): no pager, nothing to turn

events.turn: the leaf in view changed (booklet:turn): bubbling, detail { at, span }

behaviour.script: booklet.js, inside its root only: set(i) writes data-pos (past, now, next) and --k (distance from now) on each leaf, inert on the leaves out of view, the count's words and the arrows' disabled; span 2 from the container's 1200 (the CSS says so through --aj-s-booklet-span) (the spread starts on an even leaf), 1 below. Moves on the arrows, the Left and Right keys (on the booklet), a touch swipe over 50px, and a tap on a leaf's outer thirds below a 700px container (--aj-s-booklet-tap) (not on a link or button). Opens on data-at; a hash naming a leaf (#leaf-sleep, Timeline's way back) opens at that note's leaf. Under reduced motion the leaf changes at once (the CSS's guard; the motion-review switch lifts it in previews).

hooks.count: The pager's words (aria-live polite): one leaf's ("Page 2 of 6") and the spread's ("Pages 1 and 2 of 6"), the CSS showing the one in force, so a static screen reads right before any script runs.
hooks.data-page: On the root: the count for one leaf, "Page {a} of {n}" (labels.page), read by the script.
hooks.data-pages: On the root: the count for a spread, "Pages {a} and {b} of {n}" (labels.pages).

data-pos.description: On each leaf: turned, in view, still to come. Rendered for the opening leaf; the context data-pos the leaf's pictures read.

data-at.description: On the root: the first leaf in view.

a11y.role: a group with aria-roledescription "booklet" named by label; each leaf a section named "2 of 6: What you kept"; the leaves out of view inert
a11y.keyboard: Tab to the arrows; Left and Right turn the leaves while focus is in the booklet
a11y.labels: the arrows "Previous page" and "Next page"; the count announced politely

responsive.700: below 700px a tap on a leaf's outer thirds turns it
responsive.1200: from the container's 1200: open at a spread, two leaves on one paper with the fold shaded between them (ink 8% over ±30px), the stitches on the centre line, the ribbon 70px from the right, the pager stepping two leaves; below, one leaf at most --leaf-w wide, the stitches 9px in from the spine edge, the ribbon 46px from the right

changelog.change: New (v4 C3): the booklet of explore paper-story-cards d-booklet with booklet-feel f-mix (A's border and shadow, B's stitches).
The count holds the words for one leaf and for the spread, and the container rule shows the one in force: a static desktop screen read "Page 1 of 6" on a spread of leaves 1 and 2.
v4 round 10: its fixtures' note feet take the thumbs in place of That's not right.
v4 round 10: a leaf may carry a name for its label in place of the kicker (the skeleton's leaves, whose kicker is a bone).
